We achieve this by developing software and standard processes to manage and monitor these network systems. Job Description Support the daily operations of our SDN / virtual networking platform, including health checks, alert investigation, and initial troubleshooting. Gradually participate in production on-call duties after onboarding and training. Use Ansible and established procedures to deploy new clusters, update configurations, and upgrade components, with guidance from experienced engineers. Investigate Linux, networking, and service issues using logs, metrics, packet captures, and diagnostic tools. Collect relevant evidence and escalate complex issues when needed. Develop and maintain scripts, Ansible playbooks, and diagnostic tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency. Help improve monitoring, alerting, operational documentation, and runbooks. Participate in incident reviews, reliability checks, and recovery drills. Contribute to AI-assisted operations by organizing operational knowledge, integrating diagnostic tools, and validating AI-generated analysis and automation workflows. Requirements Requirements A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Basic knowledge of Linux, including common commands, processes, services, file permissions, and logs. Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, IP addressing, routing, and DNS, with the ability to reason through basic connectivity issues. Ability to write programs or scripts in at least one language, such as Python, Go, or Shell. A structured approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to investigate unfamiliar issues, test assumptions, and learn from results. Good communication and teamwork skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to follow operational procedures, document findings, and seek support when needed. Good to Have Internship, coursework, personal project, or open-source experience related to Linux, networking, backend systems, or infrastructure automation. Familiarity with Ansible, Git, or CI/CD workflows. Exposure to monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, tcpdump, or Wireshark. Basic understanding of distributed systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, or SDN. Exposure to eBPF, OVS, P4, or programmable switches is a plus. Experience using AI tools for programming, troubleshooting, or knowledge retrieval, with a habit of checking the accuracy of their outputs. Projects involving AI agents, RAG, or tool integration are also welcome.

review_candidates.title: Modern Workplace Engineer
review_candidates.description: Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen. We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. Location: London – 2 days per week (Occasional travel to Milton Keynes) Reports to: Infrastructure Engineering Manager We are excited to invite a hands-on and experienced Modern Workplace Engineer to join our team and help drive the next stage of our digital workplace transformation! In this role, you will play a vital part in shaping and optimizing how we work and collaborate through Microsoft 365, modern device management platforms, collaboration tools, and digital experience monitoring technologies. As a member of our small, multi-skilled IT team, you will have the opportunity to work across a broad modern workplace technology estate. You'll take on significant responsibilities for Amazon Connect, Atlassian Jira and Confluence administration, and Google Workspace, all within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. We’re looking for someone who can operate confidently at the platform level, taking ownership of configuration, administration, governance, integration, and continuous improvement across these technologies while ensuring a secure, reliable, and seamless employee experience. This is a high-impact, hands-on role that’s perfect for someone who is passionate about collaboration technologies, user experience, and modern device management. What You’ll Be Doing Google Workspace Administration: Manage and optimize our Google Workspace environment, including user management, access controls, security, collaboration services, and platform governance. Amazon Connect Platform Ownership: Take ownership of Amazon Connect to continuously improve the platform and optimize contact flows, routing, queues, and permissions. You will act as a technical SME, working with stakeholders to enhance the user/customer experience. Atlassian Application Management: Shape and evolve Jira and Confluence across the organization through effective workflows, permissions, schemes, automation, integrations, and governance, ensuring scalability and alignment with business processes. M365 Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve our Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Viva, and related services), ensuring availability, security, and adoption across the organization. Modern Device Management: Design, configure, and maintain device lifecycle management through Microsoft Intune and JAMF, driving a secure, zero-touch approach to provisioning and compliance. Digital Employee Experience (DEX): Own and optimize our digital user experience using DEX tooling to monitor, analyze, and continuously improve the end-user digital experience across all endpoints. Use insights to identify performance bottlenecks, enhance device health, and proactively resolve issues before they impact users. Automation & Process Improvement: Implement automation using PowerShell, Power Automate, and other M365 admin tools to simplify provisioning, onboarding, and access management. Security & Compliance Collaboration: Partner with our Security team to embed identity protection, conditional access, DLP, and compliance policies into all workplace tools. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain accurate technical documentation and contribute to the team’s knowledge base, ensuring that systems are well understood and knowledge is shared across the team. We’re looking for someone with Deep hands-on experience administering Amazon Connect, with the ability to configure, support, and optimize contact center capabilities including contact flows, routing, queues, permissions, and integrations. Proven Atlassian administration experience across Jira and Confluence, including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, governance, and platform configuration within a complex organizational environment. Demonstrable Google Workspace administration experience, including identity, access, collaboration services, security controls, user lifecycle management, and platform governance. Strong hands-on experience managing Microsoft 365 environments (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive). Practical experience with Microsoft Intune & JAMF for device and application management. Good understanding of identity and access management with Entra ID, Conditional Access, and MFA. Experience implementing collaboration governance, lifecycle management, and Teams/SharePoint structure. Experience implementing or managing DEX tooling (e.g., Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, or similar) to measure and enhance user experience and endpoint performance. Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell or Power Automate. Familiarity with Windows Autopilot and hybrid join scenarios. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment and manage multiple priorities. What You’ll Bring To The Role A passion for enabling people through technology and delivering an exceptional workplace experience. Broad technical ownership across modern workplace and SaaS platforms with the ability to move confidently between Amazon Connect, Atlassian applications, Google Workspace, M365, and Endpoint technologies. Strong security awareness and the ability to implement compliant, secure workplace practices. A continuous improvement mindset and a desire to automate manual processes. Experience working in small, agile technology teams, demonstrating the ability to contribute across a broad range of tools and platforms, including areas outside your core remit. Strong understanding of IT security practices and experience working alongside security teams to ensure infrastructure is resilient and compliant. A hands-on approach to infrastructure modernization, with an emphasis on monitoring, automation, and operational efficiency. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently and take initiative in a dynamic environment. Our Approach to AI At Rightmove, we believe software and product are ultimately people problems, and everything we build aims to improve the lives of others. We see AI as a helpful way to create more space for the human side of our work, from understanding real needs to making sure we are solving the right problems in the right way. There is an expectation that you are proactive in exploring how AI can support your own workflow and productivity, and that you approach it with curiosity and an open mind. Life at Rightmove Despite Our Growth, We’ve Remained a Friendly, Supportive Place To Work, With Employee #1 Still Working Here! We’ve Done This By Placing The Rightmove Hows At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Are The Essential Values That Reflect Our Culture, And Include We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers. We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations. We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity. We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive. We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact. We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work , we’re clearly doing something right! Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments. Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan. 27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes. Contributory stakeholder pension. Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life. Competitive compensation package. Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility. Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan. Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching. Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more. We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve. Typical working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PHT, subject to seasonal daylight saving adjustments in the US). About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated Desktop Support Specialist to join our growing global IT team. This role is responsible for providing first and second-level technical support to employees across multiple locations, ensuring a seamless end-user experience and minimizing disruption to business operations. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who enjoys troubleshooting technical issues, supporting users, and working collaboratively within a fast-paced environment. You will be responsible for maintaining desktop environments, managing endpoint devices, supporting Microsoft technologies, and assisting with SaaS administration and user access management. About Sycomp Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. What You'll Do Provide first and second-tier support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals. Support users with hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues. Troubleshoot and resolve Windows and macOS-related incidents. Assist with SaaS administration tasks and user account management. Install, configure, and maintain desktop systems, software applications, and hardware components. Manage password resets, account provisioning, and access requests. Support remote employees using remote troubleshooting tools, phone, email, and chat. Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions within the ticketing system. Perform system updates, upgrades, patching, and routine maintenance activities. Assist with endpoint management and device compliance initiatives. Maintain inventory records and track company-issued assets. Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams on projects, escalations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Deliver exceptional customer service and ensure timely resolution of user issues. What We're Looking For Minimum 3 years of experience in Desktop Support, IT Support, Help Desk, or Technical Support roles. Strong troubleshooting experience supporting Windows and macOS environments. Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 (O365). Experience administering Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. Familiarity with remote support tools and remote troubleshooting methodologies. Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP. Experience with endpoint and mobile device management solutions such as Intune and JAMF. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities. Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team environment. Strong customer service mindset and commitment to delivering a positive user experience. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certifications, or equivalent are advantageous. Why Join Sycomp? Technology Means the World to Us Technology connects people, enables business, fosters innovation, and helps organizations operate without boundaries. Every day, Sycomp’s diverse team delivers on the company’s mission to help customers and partners navigate the complexity of global IT—from cloud and data center computing to cyber security, networking, and integration and logistics across more than 150 countries. If you thrive in a growth-minded and values-driven culture, Sycomp may be your next career adventure. At Sycomp, you will have the opportunity to work in a global setting, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and be part of a dynamic and growing organization. Sycomp is known for its strong culture and commitment to employee growth. With a 93% company-wide retention rate, we foster an environment where people can make a meaningful impact, develop professionally, and build rewarding careers over the long term. Learn more about Sycomp and our employee benefits at: https://sycomp.com/careers/ Equal Opportunity Statement Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at careers@sycomp.com Sycomp may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience. These tools assist our teams, and all hiring decisions are made following human review.
